facts.text: "Snacks get passed down the aisle, nobody stands up, and I'm not slowing down for drinks. Sit tight, I'm driving."
facts.why: Annie never says this. It is in quote marks and signed Annie Porter, so it reads as a film line. A real Annie line is her joke about basing it on sex.
facts.fix: Okay. We'll have to base it on sex then.
